quiz_metadata.title: Lesson 7 Mastery Exam
quiz_metadata.topic: The Question Marker BA & Enclitic Particles

questions.prompt: What is the main function of the particle 'ba' in Tagalog?
options: It acts as a spoken question mark to turn statements into explicit questions
It marks the subject of the sentence
questions.correct_answer: It acts as a spoken question mark to turn statements into explicit questions
questions.explanation: The particle 'ba' explicitly turns a statement into a question (e.g. Aalis ka. -> Aalis ka ba?).

questions.prompt: When combining 'ba' with monosyllabic pronouns like 'ka', 'ko', or 'mo', where is 'ba' placed?
options: AFTER the monosyllabic pronoun (e.g. Aalis ka ba?)
BEFORE the monosyllabic pronoun (e.g. Aalis ba ka?)
At the very end of the sentence only
At the beginning of the sentence
questions.correct_answer: AFTER the monosyllabic pronoun (e.g. Aalis ka ba?)
questions.explanation: Monosyllabic pronouns (ka, ko, mo) come BEFORE 'ba': 'Aalis ka ba?' (NOT 'ba ka').

questions.prompt: Which particle means 'already' or 'now' (expressing finality aspect)?
questions.explanation: 'Na' means 'already' or 'now' (e.g. Uuwi ka na ba? = Are you going home already?).

questions.prompt: Which particle means 'still', 'yet', or 'more' (expressing continuation aspect)?
questions.explanation: 'Pa' means 'still' or 'yet' (e.g. Marumi pa ba siya? = Is he/she still dirty?).

questions.prompt: Which form of 'also / too' is used after a word ending in a VOWEL ('Ako ___')? ______
questions.explanation: 'Rin' is used after vowels ('Ako rin'). 'Din' is used after consonants ('Ikaw din').

questions.prompt: Which form of reported speech ('they say / reportedly') is used after a CONSONANT ('Malinis ___')? ______
questions.explanation: 'Daw' is used after consonants ('Malinis daw'). 'Raw' is used after vowels ('Ako raw').

questions.prompt: Which particle expresses emphasis or confirmation ('indeed / really')?
questions.explanation: 'Nga' is the emphasis particle meaning 'indeed' or 'really' (e.g. Mabait nga siya).

questions.prompt: Where is 'ba' placed in sentences containing question words (e.g. 'Sino', 'Ano')?
options: Immediately after the question word (e.g. Sino ba ang kasama mo?)
At the end of the sentence
questions.correct_answer: Immediately after the question word (e.g. Sino ba ang kasama mo?)
questions.explanation: In interrogative sentences, 'ba' immediately follows the question word (e.g. Sino ba, Ano ba).
